items.html: And behold, since it is now actually night, more than at the time of the evening prayer, therefore this coupling is inferior and not so excellent; and therefore it draws only from the externality of Aba and Ima alone, as mentioned. And behold, two distinctions that there are in these four kinds of Shema have been explained: and the first distinction between them is in the matter of their drawing, for their drawing is not equal. And the second distinction is in the matter of the couplings drawn from them, for they are not equal.
